name: Mosaic Scope Selector
describe: Company/Branch filter dropdown: h28 trigger on --sunk with building icon, w256 popover with heading and check on the selected row.

Header, home route only; option 1 is always "All ..." and the rest come from the user's companies or branches. Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic/src/index.css defines one light palette (:root only) and no dark: classes or .dark overrides, so the KDS has no dark theme).
